transforms.operation: Convert the English localized name to the repository force-disposition id with nameToId while retaining the dump UUID as the edge key.

filters: Use only force-disposition rows with both an id and an English localized name.
/id.reason: The current reconciliation derives stable repository ids from disposition names and uses the verified general edge to assign those ids to matching detachments; it does not generate or rewrite force-disposition entity records.

filters: Select the English localized name used by dispositionIdMap.
/name.reason: The current reconciliation reads the English display name to establish the repository identifier, but does not update the entity name field.

/text.reason: Force-disposition text is community-authored repository prose and is not copied from MFM.

/game_version.reason: The game-version reference is authored repository release metadata rather than an MFM force-disposition field.

/game_version/dataslate.reason: The dataslate label is authored repository release metadata and is not derived from the dump snapshot.

/game_version/edition.reason: The edition label is authored repository metadata and is not inferred from MFM metadata.

unmapped_mfm_fields.reason: The dump UUID is a verified relationship key; dispositionIdMap derives the repository identity from the localized name instead of exposing the UUID as the entity id.
The locale container is structural; only its selected localized name is relevant to the core entity.
The localized payload wrapper is structural; the core schema has no locale-payload field.
This edge endpoint identifies the detachment destination and is consumed by buildCanon when reconciling detachment force_dispositions, not by the force-disposition entity schema.
This edge endpoint is the dump UUID used to reach a disposition; it is translated through dispositionIdMap rather than emitted as the repository force-disposition id.
